text_block_list.text:
After an outing, on the way back
with Oguri Cap...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
*sniff sniff*... Hmm,
smells like someone's having curry for dinner.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It's somehow nostalgic.
It reminds me of the curry back home.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It was packed full of chunky, roughly chopped vegetables,
making for a very satisfying meal.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
choice_data_list: Are you hungry, by any chance?
Want to grab a bite on the way back?
Want to grab something to eat before heading back?
Want to grab a bite on the way back?
Want to grab something to eat before heading back?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Dinner's waiting back at the dorms.
Let's eat a whole bunch once we get home.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh.
The smell of curry just got stronger...
choice_data_list: You can run on ahead and head home.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
My apologies...
I am grateful, Trainer...!

Whether from the refreshing change of pace or pure hunger,
Oguri Cap ran off at even greater speed than usual.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...
I was just thinking of doing the same.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'll eat my fill and get ready
for tomorrow's training...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"So... um,
would it be alright if I made a request?"
choice_data_list: You want to eat curry, don't you?
You wanna have curry, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: How did you know...? Trainer, you're amazing...

Afterward, we ate curry at the shopping district
and recharged our energy.
